overview_description.description: Arknet is a decentralized network designed to create a more open, transparent, and energy-efficient internet. At its core is Ark, a novel alternative to LLMs, a community-driven artificial intelligence system that facilitates communication and execution across multiple endpoints, including blockchain transactions, AI model training, and inference APIs.
